scope: Identical closed fixture copies, public owned-mode calls, initial full audit charged as openMs, all three scale queries.
path_redaction: Only path labels are normalized below. Every recorded sample, duration, answer check and resource observation is retained.
limitations: Two pairs and five measured calls per reader are an exploratory comparison, not a latency SLO.
All three query kinds run after one public owned-store open per cell. Initial full audit and supplemental audit are charged in openMs.
Every candidate first/measured sample must report owned_unique_scalable_*; every disabled baseline sample must report owned_scalable_*.
The raw data retains substantial 16-reader sum throughput variance and large baseline outliers. No samples were discarded.
The DuckDB memory setting is 2GB, while measured whole-process peak RSS reaches approximately 2.9GB.
Current uniqueness requires the audited native-owned write boundary. Quiescent raw dispatch invalidates before mutation. Explicit historical cuts keep DISTINCT.
Other experimental optimizations are disabled. No feature is promoted by this receipt.
